evidence.quote: Chisenhale Gallery was founded by artists.

findings.value: Entry is free. Open Wednesday to Sunday, 12 to 6pm.

notes: Contemporary art gallery that also runs panel discussions and curatorial tours alongside its exhibitions. Nights seen: Panel discussion, 29 October, 7-8:30pm, for the Wakaliga Uganda show (upcoming); Panel discussion, 5 November, 7-8:30pm (upcoming); Curatorial tour, 3 December, 7-8:30pm (upcoming); Exhibition 'Kibuuka Omumbaale', until 6 December (current). No music nights found.
